# Automotive Solutions by Single

> Family owned auto repair shop in Elk Grove, California, serving drivers since
> 2001. ASE certified technicians and a NAPA AutoCare Center. Repair, service
> and maintenance on all makes and models of domestic and import vehicles.

**Promise:** Diagnosis first. Price before work. Nothing you did not approve.

## Facts

- Name: Automotive Solutions by Single (also listed as "Automotive Solutions")
- Address: 9253 Elk Grove Blvd, Elk Grove, CA 95624
- Phone: (916) 686-5277
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
- Founded: 2001, family owned and operated
- Certifications: ASE certified technicians; NAPA AutoCare Center
- Warranty: NAPA Peace of Mind — 24 months / 24,000 miles on parts and labor for
  qualifying repairs, honored at NAPA AutoCare Centers nationwide
- Rating: 4.5 out of 5 from 55 Google reviews (checked 2026-09-01). This site
  does not publish its own aggregateRating markup; read the reviews at the source.
- Serving: Elk Grove, Laguna, Sacramento, Wilton, Galt, Florin, Vineyard,
  Sheldon, Franklin, Rancho Cordova
- Languages: English, Spanish
